title: SessionToggleMcpServer
description: Switches one MCP server of a running session on or off. Only the owner of the session may, and only a server the session has. The ack comes before the effect; the result arrives as `session.mcpStatusChanged`, with the session's `seq` — and none when nothing changed.

name.description: The server's name, as `session.mcpStatusChanged` gave it.
